import copy
import unittest

from solution import apply_membership_commands


class MembershipCommandTests(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_normal_sequence_deduplication_and_stable_results(self):
        commands = [
            {"op": "add", "name": "  Ada  ", "tags": ["red", "blue", "red"]},
            {"op": "add", "name": "Bob", "tags": []},
            {"op": "retag", "id": 1, "tags": ["green", "green", "red"]},
            {"op": "get", "id": 1},
            {"op": "list"},
            {"op": "remove", "id": 2},
            {"op": "list"},
        ]
        original = copy.deepcopy(commands)
        result = apply_membership_commands(commands)

        self.assertEqual(commands, original)
        self.assertEqual(result, [
            {"ok": True, "member": {"id": 1, "name": "Ada", "tags": ["red", "blue"]}},
            {"ok": True, "member": {"id": 2, "name": "Bob", "tags": []}},
            {"ok": True, "member": {"id": 1, "name": "Ada", "tags": ["green", "red"]}},
            {"ok": True, "member": {"id": 1, "name": "Ada", "tags": ["green", "red"]}},
            {"ok": True, "members": [
                {"id": 1, "name": "Ada", "tags": ["green", "red"]},
                {"id": 2, "name": "Bob", "tags": []},
            ]},
            {"ok": True},
            {"ok": True, "members": [
                {"id": 1, "name": "Ada", "tags": ["green", "red"]},
            ]},
        ])

        result[0]["member"]["tags"].append("changed")
        self.assertEqual(result[2]["member"]["tags"], ["green", "red"])
        result[4]["members"][0]["tags"].append("changed")
        self.assertEqual(result[3]["member"]["tags"], ["green", "red"])
        self.assertEqual(result[6]["members"][0]["tags"], ["green", "red"])

    def test_invalid_commands_do_not_change_state_or_consume_ids(self):
        commands = [
            {"op": "add", "name": "One", "tags": ["a"]},
            {"op": "retag", "id": 99, "tags": ["x"]},
            {"op": "add", "name": "   ", "tags": []},
            {"op": "add", "name": "Bad", "tags": ["ok", ""]},
            {"op": "get", "id": True},
            {"op": "remove", "id": 1, "extra": 0},
            {"op": "unknown"},
            ["not", "a", "dict"],
            {"op": "list", "id": 1},
            {"op": "add", "name": "Two", "tags": []},
            {"op": "list"},
        ]
        result = apply_membership_commands(commands)
        invalid = {"ok": False, "error": "invalid"}
        self.assertEqual(result[1:9], [invalid] * 8)
        self.assertEqual(result[9]["member"]["id"], 2)
        self.assertEqual(result[10]["members"], [
            {"id": 1, "name": "One", "tags": ["a"]},
            {"id": 2, "name": "Two", "tags": []},
        ])

    def test_empty_and_top_level_type(self):
        self.assertEqual(apply_membership_commands([]), [])
        for value in (None, {}, (), ""):
            with self.subTest(value=value):
                with self.assertRaises(TypeError):
                    apply_membership_commands(value)


if __name__ == "__main__":
    unittest.main()
